text: Building the future of AI takes a global supply chain. We’re expanding commitments with Amkor Technology, Foxconn, Kinsus, Samsung Electro-Mechanics, SPIL and TSMC, building on previously announced commitments with IBIDEN, KYEC and Unimicron. Together, we’re building the
zh: 英伟达：将扩大与安靠、富士康、景硕、三星电机、矽品和台积电的合作承诺，并延续此前与揖斐电、京元电子和欣兴电子的安排，加码全球 AI 供应链。

text: The Starbase tower chopsticks catching their first Starship. This unique architecture was designed for full and rapid reusability, enabling repeat launches and landings from the same pad
zh: SpaceX：星舰基地发射塔“筷子”完成首次捕获星舰；该架构旨在实现快速完全重复使用，可在同一发射台反复发射和着陆。

text: "This is not a cyberattack and this is not a coordinated effort by a nation-state." - Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton.
zh: 白宫：国家情报总监克莱顿称，此事并非网络攻击，也不是某个国家的协同行动。

text: NEWS: NVIDIA announces financial results for third quarter fiscal 2027. Revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% from a year ago. Data Center revenue of $107.6 billion, up 110% from a year ago.
zh: 英伟达：公布 2027 财年第三季度业绩，营收 1158 亿美元、同比增长 103%，数据中心营收 1076 亿美元、同比增长 110%。

text: With Meta’s latest models coming to Foundry, we’re giving developers and enterprises even more choice and flexibility! — quoting: Muse Wonder, Muse Spark 1.3, and Muse Ember are coming soon to Microsoft Foundry on @Azure.
zh: 纳德拉：Meta 最新模型将登陆 Foundry，为开发者和企业提供更多选择 —— 引用称：Muse Wonder、Muse Spark 1.3 和 Muse Ember 即将登陆 Azure 上的 Microsoft Foundry。

text: 6.2 Sol and Astra are out. These models can do amazing things and are very token-efficient; we hope people will get great value from them. In particular, 6.2 Sol ultrafast is something I think people will really enjoy.
zh: 奥特曼：GPT-6.2 的 Sol 与 Astra 已发布，强调高 token 效率；尤其推荐 6.2 Sol 超快版。

text: Congress was warned. FAA infrastructure badly needs funding. The old systems need to be upgraded for the safety and security of the American people.
zh: 白宫：国会此前已接到警告；联邦航空管理局基础设施急需拨款，旧系统须升级，以保障美国民众的安全。

text: After 34 days docked to the @Space_Station, the Dragon spacecraft supporting SpaceX’s 35th Commercial Resupply Services mission for @NASA is targeted to undock from the orbiting lab as soon as Wednesday, November 18
zh: SpaceX：执行第 35 次商业补给任务的龙飞船在空间站停靠 34 天后，最早将于 11 月 18 日（周三）撤离。

text: President Trump continues to safeguard American citizens, and today @FinCENnews proposal takes the next step in implementing the President’s historic Executive Order, “Restoring Integrity to America’s Financial System.” This action will strengthen customer due diligence
zh: 美国财政部：金融犯罪执法网络（FinCEN）今日提出新方案，落实“恢复美国金融体系诚信”行政令，将加强客户尽职调查。

text: Some of you have been asking very politely. Some of you have just been asking. GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol are now available. Super efficient and built to perform where it counts—the real world.
zh: OpenAI：GPT-6.2 的 Astra 与 Sol 现已上线，称其高效并面向实际应用。

text: Knowing things → doing things → finding ways to save you time and money. We’re expanding Tasks in Gemini free of charge to hundreds of millions of people in six countries. Powered by Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Tasks lets you hand off everyday life admin directly: - Forward emails to
zh: 皮查伊：将向六个国家数亿用户免费开放 Gemini 任务功能，由 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 驱动，可代办邮件转发等日常事务。

text: Join us in getting a look at the universe as it has never been seen before. On Dec. 7, at 3:30pm ET (2030 UTC), @NASARoman’s first images will be unveiled during a livestream from @theAGU Annual Meeting. Learn how to tune in:
zh: NASA：罗马太空望远镜首批图像将于 12 月 7 日 15:30（美东时间，世界时 20:30）在美国地球物理联合会年会上直播公布。

text: Advanced solid state transformers at scale from Tesla — quoting: Introducing Powercore. Solid state medium voltage transformer, inverter and breaker – reliable, safe and secure. 7.4 MW/9 MVA continuously at 34.5 kVac w/ grid-forming support for 10MVA of peak power. Made in America. Operating 2027
zh: 马斯克：特斯拉将大规模推出先进固态变压器 —— 引用称：Powercore 为固态中压变压器、逆变器与断路器一体，可持续输出 7.4 兆瓦/9 兆伏安，并支持 10 兆伏安峰值，美国制造，2027 年投运。

text: President Trump & Thai Prime Minister Charnvirakul sign a reciprocal trade agreement, eliminating all tariffs on U.S. exports & securing an estimated $2.6B in U.S. agricultural purchases. A major win for American farmers, American businesses, & U.S.-Thailand trade.
zh: 白宫：特朗普与泰国总理猜瑟瓦签署对等贸易协定，取消对美出口全部关税，并锁定约 26 亿美元美国农产品采购。

text: October #IndustrialProduction: Total -0.4%, Mfg. +0.3%, Utilities -4.3%, Mining -0.8%; #CapacityUtilization 76.4%
zh: 美联储：10 月工业产出下降 0.4%，其中制造业升 0.3%、公用事业降 4.3%、采矿业降 0.8%；产能利用率为 76.4%。

text: The NVIDIA Board of Directors has established the National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee. Read the release:
zh: 英伟达：董事会已设立国家安全与出口管制监督委员会。

text: Our Hera mission is now studying asteroid Didymos from just 28.5 km away in visible light and infrared to reveal its surface features, composition and temperature. These observations will help us better understand asteroid properties and improve planetary defence.
zh: 欧空局：Hera探测器已在距双旋星小行星28.5公里处进行可见光与红外观测，以了解其表面特征、成分和温度，并改进行星防御。

text:
VP JD Vance on much-needed infrastructure funding for the FAA:

“Sometimes you have to work on a patchwork of solutions to keep a 50-year-old system up and running, why do we have a 50-year-old system in the first place?”
zh: 白宫：万斯谈FAA急需基建资金：为何还在靠打补丁维持一套已运行50年的系统？

text:
ChatGPT for Healthcare is advancing with more capable computer-use agents, stronger clinical answers, and 20+ new healthcare plugins.

AbridgeHQ, AmbienceAI, Cigna, CVSHealth, and other leading healthcare organizations are putting our models to work across prior
zh: OpenAI：ChatGPT医疗版升级，电脑操作智能体更强、临床回答更好，并新增20余个医疗插件；包括信诺、CVS健康等机构已在使用。

text:
As I was saying …

Free Starlinks for FAA were offered to Sec Duffy, but he said they were not needed. As it turns out, they were.
zh: 马斯克：此前已向运输部长达菲提供免费星链给联邦航空局，对方称不需要；事实证明其实需要。

text: Views from Mechazilla of the first ever Starship catch
zh: SpaceX：机械臂「Mechazilla」视角下，星舰首次成功捕获。

text:
We’re developing a quantum-classical codesign platform with @IBM and @Fermilab to advance practical quantum computing.

NVIDIA DGX B200 systems will connect with IBM quantum computers to accelerate error-correction and applications research. Separately, our new TCBP-JOBS decoder
zh: 英伟达：正与IBM和费米实验室开发量子-经典协同设计平台，DGX B200将连接IBM量子计算机，加速纠错与应用研究。

text:
Scientists reported nearly doubling their productivity with AI in our study of more than 1,800 participants in the ChatGPT for Academic Researchers program.

Using privacy-preserving methods, we looked at how they use ChatGPT across their work—from developing ideas to analyzing
zh: OpenAI：对1800多名参与「ChatGPT学术研究」项目的科学家调研显示，使用人工智能后其生产率接近翻倍。

text:
We’re expanding free access to our frontier models for up to 200,000 scientists worldwide, with training and support.

Applications open Nov. 23. By default, we don’t use data shared through the program to train our models.
zh: OpenAI：将把前沿模型免费使用权扩大至全球最多20万名科学家，并提供培训支持；11月23日起开放申请，默认不用项目数据训练模型。

text:
Today at #SC26, we announced the NVIDIA Vera CPU rack-scale platform for high-performance computing.

Pairing our first fully custom data center CPU with NVIDIA Quantum-X800 InfiniBand, Vera delivers up to 2x greater energy efficiency than x86. That means faster answers on
zh: 英伟达：在SC26发布Vera CPU机架级高性能计算平台，首款全自研数据中心CPU搭配Quantum-X800 InfiniBand，能效最高可达x86的两倍。

text:
Chairman Warsh delivers opening remarks at the Federal Reserve’s Productivity and Jobs Task Force Conference hosted by the @sffed:

Watch live:

Learn more about Chairman Warsh:
zh: 美联储：主席沃什在旧金山联储主办的生产率与就业特别工作组会议上致开幕辞。

text:
Our planetary defence mission Hera is about to reveal the first detailed images of asteroid Dimorphos since NASA’s DART impact in 2022.

Journalists, join our media briefing on 25 November, in Berlin or online.

Register by 23 November:
zh: 欧空局：行星防御任务Hera即将公布自2022年NASA的DART撞击以来双小行星Dimorphos的首批详细图像；11月25日将在柏林或线上举行媒体简报。

text: President Donald J. Trump departs for a major trip to Asia with his first stop to the Philippines for the ASEAN Summit, followed by a visit to Shenzhen, China, for the APEC Leaders' Summit. Peace through strength.
zh: 白宫：特朗普启程亚洲之行，先赴菲律宾出席东盟峰会，再访中国深圳参加APEC领导人峰会。

text:
Ready to build your own agent to speed scientific discovery?

Introducing Nemotron for Science, helping researchers develop agents that reason through scientific problems and put specialized research tools to work.

Used by @argonne, @RIKEN_en & more. #SC26
zh: 英伟达：推出面向科学的Nemotron，帮助研究人员开发能推理科学问题并调用专业研究工具的智能体；阿贡、理研等已在使用。

text:
We’re working with @ApolloResearch, @METR_Evals, @TransluceAI, and @GoodfireAI on embedded assessments: giving outside experts deep access to our internal models and systems to investigate alignment and test our safeguards.

These assessments build on our ongoing alignment and
zh: OpenAI：正与Apollo Research、METR、Transluce、Goodfire合作开展嵌入式评估，让外部专家深入访问内部模型与系统，核查对齐并测试安全措施。

text: President Trump on Friday's FAA ground stop:  "We have old equipment, broken equipment. We've been telling that to Congress... We essentially want to blow it up and put new in... We need the funding to get it done."
zh: 白宫：特朗普谈周五联邦航空局停飞：设备陈旧损坏，已向国会反复说明，希望推倒重来装上新设备，需要拨款完成。

text:
Speech by Governor Barr on some potential financial stability implications of artificial intelligence:

Watch live:

Learn more about Governor Barr:
zh: 美联储：巴尔理事将就人工智能对金融稳定的潜在影响发表讲话，并可在线收看。

text: The amount of energy we harness for civilization from the Sun will obviously ultimately round up to 100% of all energy. That math is obvious and trivial.
zh: 马斯克：文明从太阳获取的能源，最终将占全部能源的100%，这个数学道理显而易见、很简单。

text:
Starship V4 will be ~70m long, which is roughly a 40% length increase and allows >60% more propellant load.

Engine count will be raised to 9, with 3 more Raptor-Vacuum engines added, and these will be higher thrust V4 engines.
zh: 马斯克：星舰V4将约70米长，长度增加约40%，可多装逾60%推进剂；发动机增至9台，再加3台更高推力的V4真空猛禽。

text: Starlink helps rural schools with education — quoting: BREAKING: Every rural municipal school in Rondonópolis, Brazil, now has Starlink internet. Students and teachers can now access digital libraries, educational videos and online learning tools. SpaceX is bringing a world of knowledge to remote classrooms.
zh: 马斯克：星链已覆盖巴西龙多诺波利斯全部乡村市立学校，师生可使用数字图书馆和在线学习工具。

text:
Physicist Nathaniel Craig shares how he worked with GPT-6 Astra to develop a candidate lattice definition of the Standard Model.

It’s the first post on our new science blog:
zh: OpenAI：物理学家 Nathaniel Craig 介绍与 GPT-6 Astra 合作提出标准模型的候选格点定义，并开设新科学博客。
